lesson: A fresh task worktree has NO node_modules and NO built contract. 'forge task start' cuts a sibling worktree from the trunk, which carries source but not installed dependencies or contract/dist, so the first delegate run blocks on missing Prettier, TypeScript and test runners AFTER it has already made real edits. Run 'npm ci' and 'npm run -w contract build' in the worktree before delegating.
source: ask-period-contract-and-branch first delegate run, blocked: 'node_modules is absent, so Prettier, TypeScript, and required tests cannot run'
